I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message: the ticket is **#8841**.

That comes from his own message in #central-random yesterday (13 Oct, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. That message calls it "Tobias's dealer account", not Marrow Fieldworks by name. A January handoff note says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands, so it's very likely the same account, but I can't confirm that. I asked him to check before it goes in the weekly notes.

I left out the guess about a future ticket number that he told me privately in his DM.
